inventory.alt: Imagined scene: Wild waves break over a low rocky reef beneath dark clouds.
inventory.textBasis: Jude 1:13 compares the criticized people to wild/raging foaming sea waves. Low reefs also resonate with the ASV/WEB 1:12 metaphor; KJV says spots. Landscape is a literary illustration, not an asserted narrated storm or precise coast. Storm clouds and distant rain are not offered as a literal rendering of the separate clouds-without-water simile in 1:12. No named person, animal, love-feast, Michael/Moses dispute or Enoch judgment scene is invented.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Native 960x540: breaking wave crests, spray and white foam, overlapping foreground currents and flow around rocks; wet rock planes and green growth; right-hand coast and receding hills; horizon, cloud layers, distant rain and daylight opening. No definite malformed object, human/animal anatomy, lettering or signature. Exact coast/date, rock/geological species, weather and physical ocean simulation not certified.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; hands/fingers/thumbs/limbs/identity/aging comparisons not applicable.
